description: Restart one of the signed-in user's experiments that a safety answer paused (POST /me/experiments/:id/restart), with the restart record: the user's own account, never filled in for them. First ask the screen again (`renewedScreen`: the check-in safety questions, the warning signs and the pregnancy and breastfeeding status, from supstack_experiments_get → checkInQuestions); an answer there that needs help stops the restart with `safetyAction`: relay it first, word for word. Then `restartRecord`, in their words: reviewerRole (doctor, pharmacist, nurse, midwife, other-clinician), reviewedOn YYYY-MM-DD, dose, productForm, restartPlan, clinicianAdvisedRestart true ONLY if a clinician ADVISED they can restart this product in this form and at this dose (having contacted one is not enough), seriousInjury and seriousIllness (each excluded, confirmed, suspected-or-unresolved or not-discussed, never a false "excluded"), eventResolution (resolved, stable, not-resolved, as the clinician assessed it), illnessAssessmentComplete (only for a suspected illness). Pharmacist ruling 354 (option 3): only seriousInjury "excluded" (the clinician explicitly ruled out a serious reaction to this product) may go on to the other restart checks. confirmed, suspected-or-unresolved, not-discussed, missing or unknown are held whatever clearance is recorded, refused with 409 product_reaction_held: relay its message first, and never invite the user to change a real event into a mistake. A clearance reference never means the clinician ruled it out. Ruling 355: seriousIllness not-discussed is held until the clinician assesses it. confirmed needs eventResolution resolved or stable as the clinician assessed it, plus clearanceReference (documented advice for this exact product). suspected-or-unresolved needs all of that and illnessAssessmentComplete true, only if the user says the clinician completed a safety assessment and documented that this exact product may be restarted despite the uncertain diagnosis. A refusal that carries `eligibility` (the pharmacist's complete rule: the pre-start form on a start, the restart form on a restart) must be shown to the user word for word, after the refusal's `message`. Never summarise it. A refusal with `app_restart_unavailable` or `permanently_excluded` is not released by any record: relay its `message` word for word. Also otherExposures (or "none"), clearanceReference for a documented clearance, and maternityAssessed with pregnancyPlan for a maternity event. Pharmacist ruling 281 call 1: when the pause names more than one illness (`restartMustRecordExcluded`), ask about EACH one and pass `seriousIllnessBy` ({ illness: decision }); a single `seriousIllness` is acceptable only after you showed the user the complete named list and they confirmed it applies to all of it (`seriousIllnessAppliesToAll: true`). Missing or unknown never counts as ruled out. Ruling 293/T3 (K28): a pause naming a serious skin reaction needs `sjsTen`, asked as "What did the clinician conclude about this product and Stevens–Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis?" with exactly four answers: confirmed-culprit (never restarted, the product is excluded for good), ruled-out (specifically assessed and ruled out: the only one that restarts), suspected (still suspected or assessment unfinished) or not-assessed (not assessed or unsure). suspected and not-assessed stay excluded pending specialist assessment (409 sjs_ten_assessment_pending): no clearance overrides them. "They did not confirm it" is not ruled-out: ask again. Ruling 280: when the user is pregnant or breastfeeding and `populationPlansRequired` is set, either pass `currentRegimen` (and `currentLactation` when breastfeeding) to compare with the plan on record, or record the plan in `populationPlans` (the exact product, ingredients, chemical form, route, amount as a number with unit mg/mcg/g/IU/ml, per-dose or daily-total, ingredient-equivalent or compound-mass, release, timesPer per day or week, schedule; for breastfeeding every child's age in months, prematurity and health, the feeding pattern and breast-milk share; reviewer, date, advice use/restart/do-not-use with their words, monitoring, reasons to reassess, maternal health, concurrent products, documentedAt for an avoid product; coversBoth only when one consultation covered both). Never tell them to stop breastfeeding or prescribed medicine. A 409 `restart_record_incomplete` or `population_plan_required` lists `restartRecordProblems`: ask for exactly those. A 409 `status_hold` with `heldExperiment`: another experiment's answer holds every restart, relay its message. A status hold is not restarted here: use supstack_experiment_correct. The pause is of the optional supplement experiment only, never of prescribed medicine. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_restart
